dedupe_keys.name: data of the spanish electric power system idesignres

description: This data set describes Spain's transmission grid and generation fleet for use as test data in energy system models. It was published on Zenodo in January 2025 by Ehsan Nokandi for the EU iDesignRES project, under tasks that gathered detailed electricity and gas system data for Spain. It gives the transmission grid at 220 kV and above in its actual form, without aggregation or loss of spatial resolution, generation data for all conventional units above 1 MW, and a best estimate of how renewable generation is distributed across the network. National electricity demand time series come from the ENTSO-E Transparency Platform and are spread spatially across buses using population distribution data. Coverage is Spain's transmission system. Files are a ZIP of data with a PDF description, downloadable from Zenodo (version 1.0.0) under CC BY 4.0 at no cost. Caveats: renewable locations and nodal demand are estimated, not measured, and the companion gas data are not in this record. Simulation uses are power flow, capacity expansion and sector-coupling model tests for Spain. Related records: data-idesignres-heat-demand-district-heating-nuts2 comes from the same project.
